depiction.primary_object: two horizontal lines paired with two checkmarks
depiction.composition: two stacked rows, lines on left and checkmarks on right

ambiguity: Almost identical to standard checklist icons where checkmarks are on the left; inside a to-do app, a generic checklist icon can be redundant with the app's UI chrome unless the task specifically produces or reviews a checklist.

modifier_semantics.meaning: completed, verified, checked off, or approved items

reasoning: Shows two list rows with checkmarks on the right, universally understood as a checklist or verification list. In a to-do app it is best reserved for tasks that are explicitly about creating, printing, or running through a checklist or inspection, though it is scarcely distinguishable from left-aligned checklist icons.
